brief: Media reports suggest NVDA's Board is preparing to oust Jensen Huang as CEO and is working with an outside firm on successor candidates. UBS says impact would be felt widely in three areas. First, financing: NVDA generates roughly $50-60B/quarter in FCF, much of it recycled into AI-ecosystem financing for neo-clouds, LLM developers and suppliers; a pause under new leadership could pull roughly $50B or more out of the system, at least temporarily, at a time of rising rates and less liquid credit segments. Second, supply chain: NVDA has been far ahead of peers in long-term agreements (memory, substrates), with Jensen viewed as singular in procurement. Third, potential for tighter US restrictions on shipments to China and to Singapore/Malaysia, which UBS estimates could put roughly 10% of revenue at risk. UBS treats the succession itself as unconfirmed and says any impact would take years to manifest; it keeps its Buy rating and $300 price target unchanged, based on 14x C2028E P/E on $22.08 EPS.
